PhotosModerate uploads, publish photos, and run guest tagging. → /admin/photos
AlbumsArrange the live order inside each public album. → /admin/albums
People ReviewWork through face review and named people. → /admin/review
Photo ClaimsReview and approve photo ownership and face tag claims. → /admin/claims
FeaturedSet what appears in the homepage and film page spotlight sections. → /admin/featured
Audit TrailSee who changed moderation state and when. → /admin/audit
AnalyticsTrack verified database activity inside the app. → /admin/analytics
SettingsReference the live setup and operating notes. → /admin/settings
Watch the filmRevisit the ceremony, speeches, and the whole dance floor arc. → /film
Browse the galleryPortraits, candids, and every little detail we never want to forget. → /gallery
Leave a noteA quiet last stop for one message, blessing, or little memory from the day. → /guestbook
Memory BookPrint a keepsake photo book or guestbook — save as PDF from any browser. → /print

Admin is for moderation, people review, and verified site data. Traffic and error dashboards still live in Google Analytics and Sentry.

rebuild: Use the Supabase email and password for your admin account to review uploads, moderate the guestbook, and manage the wedding archive.
The same Supabase authentication already wired into the app. There are no hardcoded admin credentials in the codebase.
Access is granted only when the signed-in user has `role: admin` in Supabase user metadata.
Once you can sign in here, we can set your Supabase user metadata so this page upgrades from “authenticated” to full admin access.
Enter the email and password for the Supabase user you just created.
